answer_1.quote: The Foreground Designer agent serves as the creative cornerstone of our system, generating a structured blueprint for all foreground elements encoded as a JSON-structured schema-defining precise positioning, styling, and content for logos, campaign texts, call-to-action buttons, and decorative elements.
answer_1.outputs: JSON blueprints, SVG code, Figma plugin code

answer_2.quote: To evaluate banner design quality, we developed six metrics (Tab. 1) from extensive literature survey on banner design principles... including results using general design metrics in Appendix A.4.

answer_3.quote: Third, a human-LLM correlation study validating the alignment between GPT-4o's automated scoring and human perception across six proposed metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conducted three human evaluations... with 20 participants comparing banner designs... 15 participants assessed quality progression... 17-19 participants independently grading 25 representative images per metric.
answer_4.guideline: Rating initial and best versions on 5-point scale; pairwise comparisons; independent grading per metric
